item.text: The checkout is an older Go Teleport tree and already documents `kube_listen_addr` for standalone Kubernetes services. I’m narrowing down whether the proxy-side config can reuse that address type and how clients currently choose the Kubernetes proxy endpoint, while leaving generated/build artifacts out of scope.

func (s *ConfigTestSuite) TestBackendDefaults(c *check.C) {
	read := func(val string) *service.Config {
		// Default value is lite backend.
		conf, err := ReadConfig(bytes.NewBufferString(val))
		c.Assert(err, check.IsNil)
		c.Assert(conf, check.NotNil)

		cfg := service.MakeDefaultConfig()
		err = ApplyFileConfig(conf, cfg)
		c.Assert(err, check.IsNil)
		return cfg
	}

	// Default value is lite backend.
	cfg := read(`teleport:
  data_dir: /var/lib/teleport
`)
	c.Assert(cfg.Auth.StorageConfig.Type, check.Equals, lite.GetName())
	c.Assert(cfg.Auth.StorageConfig.Params[defaults.BackendPath], check.Equals, filepath.Join("/var/lib/teleport", defaults.BackendDir))

	// If no path is specified, the default is picked. In addition, internally
	// dir gets converted into lite.
	cfg = read(`teleport:
     data_dir: /var/lib/teleport
     storage:
       type: dir
`)
	c.Assert(cfg.Auth.StorageConfig.Type, check.Equals, lite.GetName())
	c.Assert(cfg.Auth.StorageConfig.Params[defaults.BackendPath], check.Equals, filepath.Join("/var/lib/teleport", defaults.BackendDir))

	// Support custom paths for dir/lite backends.
	cfg = read(`teleport:
     data_dir: /var/lib/teleport
     storage:
       type: dir
       path: /var/lib/teleport/mybackend
`)
	c.Assert(cfg.Auth.StorageConfig.Type, check.Equals, lite.GetName())
	c.Assert(cfg.Auth.StorageConfig.Params[defaults.BackendPath], check.Equals, "/var/lib/teleport/mybackend")

	// Kubernetes proxy is disabled by default.
	cfg = read(`teleport:
     data_dir: /var/lib/teleport
`)
	c.Assert(cfg.Proxy.Kube.Enabled, check.Equals, false)
}

item.text:
Implemented `proxy_service.kube_listen_addr` shorthand with Kubernetes default port handling, enablement, conflict validation, and precedence over an explicitly disabled legacy block. Added a warning for enabled standalone Kubernetes services when the proxy has no Kubernetes listener address.

Client address resolution now replaces `0.0.0.0` and `::` listener hosts with the web proxy host, while preserving Kubernetes public address priority.

Verification passed: `go test ./lib/config ./lib/client` and `git diff --check`. Updates are in [fileconf.go](/app/lib/config/fileconf.go), [configuration.go](/app/lib/config/configuration.go), and [api.go](/app/lib/client/api.go).
